claims.explanation: Teniposide is a topoisomerase II poison that preferentially targets TOP2A (p170), so high TOP2A expression and proliferative/DNA-damage-responsive states sensitize while low target or high drug efflux protects. ABCC3/MRP3 and related ABC transporters lower intracellular drug, and SLFN11 expression is a known topoisomerase-inhibitor sensitivity biomarker. Defects in DNA-damage response (ATM) and proliferation-associated FBXW7 loss may further sensitize, whereas NF1 loss may promote survival.
